source_name: President of Iceland english.forseti.is English speech PDFs (Wayback/CDX)
notes: Probe-validated 2026-07-27 (--spread --n 8): 139 English speech PDFs under english.forseti.is/media/PDF (139 raw) + /media/files (21), after excluding third-language translations. TEXT extracts cleanly 1.9k-21.8k chars; DATE from the filename via url_regex on the 4-digit-year files; TITLE from the PDF's first line (strong here, e.g. 'A Speech by the President of Iceland Ólafur Ragnar Grímsson at the opening of The Arctic Circle Assembly Reykjavik 12 October 2013'); speaker_default Ólafur Ragnar Grímsson (single-president window - these stores span ~1996-2016). ⚠️ CORRECTS AN EARLIER 'NOT VIABLE' VERDICT: the first triage queried forseti.is with CDX matchType=HOST, which EXCLUDES SUBDOMAINS, so english.forseti.is (1,080 captures) never appeared and Iceland was written off as having no archived English. matchType=DOMAIN is the fix - it also surfaces olafur.forseti.is and gudni.forseti.is, the per-president archive subdomains. WHY PDFs: english.forseti.is has only ~298 archived text/html captures and they are all institutional pages (FormerPresidents, Pictures, the /SelectedSpeeches/<year>/ indexes) - there are NO individual HTML speech pages, and the engine cannot crawl an archived listing anyway, so the recipe goes straight at the PDF objects. LANGUAGE WAS VERIFIED BY EXTRACTION, NOT INFERRED - two findings drove the design: (1) /media/PDF and /media/files are genuine English, but /media/<numeric-id>/ on the SAME hostname is ICELANDIC (a shared Umbraco media library; /media/14142/2024_08_01-innsetning-raeda-2024.pdf extracts 'INNSETNINGARRÆÐA HÖLLU TÓMASDÓTTUR', 0 English words / 213 Icelandic chars) so that prefix is excluded; (2) the site is a MULTILINGUAL archive - a *_thyska file extracts GERMAN - so translations are excluded by a token list BUILT FROM DATA (tallying the final filename token across all 160 PDFs), which caught SHORT forms (_dan, .dansk, _nor) that a first pass using only long forms (danska/norska) leaked. Tokens are matched exactly between separators so 'Nordurslodir' is not mistaken for the 'nor' tag. DATE: the strict month/day alternatives are deliberate - a loose \d{2} matches the real file 2017_31_05_finnlandheimsokn.pdf as month=31, and the engine then falls back to parse_date('2017'), i.e. a silently WRONG date; 2-digit-year filenames (08.02.21.) are left undated by design since YY.MM.DD vs DD.MM.YY is ambiguous. Companion to the live Icelandic isl_forseti.yml and to isl_forseti_wayback. FULL RUN is the researcher's gate.
